usage: After operator review, save as literal_search.py and run with Python 3 on Linux or macOS: python3 literal_search.py < request.json. Input is one object containing root, query, and path; example: {"root":"/approved/folder","query":"item-example","path":"."}. The caller must approve root before invocation. Searches regular UTF-8 files recursively, including hidden files; returns root-relative paths sorted by path and line, with one result per matching line. Matching is literal, case-sensitive, and confined to individual lines. Invalid UTF-8 files and discovered symlinks are skipped. Explicit symlink targets, paths outside root (including ../), missing targets, and filesystem errors return {"error":"invalid_input"}; no matches returns {"matches":[]}. Uses only the standard library, performs no writes or network calls, and has not been executed against the supplied fixture paths.
